sourceTraceSupplement.text: - Load catalog information and artwork from Jellyfin. Concurrent sort/filter reads for an unchanged selection must not report that the library changed merely because another view was read or cached results were evicted. Changing the actual account or selected libraries still rejects obsolete reads; a later explicit refresh reads the server again. Refresh library updates current songs and genre/tag choices, and marks cached song details, album views and playlists for a fresh read when used. Keep search, filters, selection and the listening queue during refresh. Keep the Refresh action focused while it is busy and after success or failure, unless the listener moves elsewhere. Show busy feedback, ignore repeat activation until the refresh settles, and allow Tab to continue normally. Show read failures with Retry while retaining available data. An open album reads its current title, artist, year and artwork by ID, even if it has no tracks; a metadata-only failure must leave available tracks playable. Use Jellyfin’s image revision tags for current artwork, including a song’s album-art fallback. Refreshing the collection never prepares news or enables radio.

| M5 | I can find music and recover from a failed page | I am browsing a growing library or narrowing it by artist, album, genre or tag | Use Command-F to search, filter, select songs, open an album and return; Retry if the next page fails | Keep keyboard-focused rows/controls visible above the selection toolbar and player in songs, albums and playlists; quick arrow presses retain every move; show each song/album once across overlapping selected libraries, with unique totals and coherent pages; concurrent sort/filter reads of an unchanged selection do not falsely claim the library changed; Refresh rereads the server after a completed read, retains its focused action through busy/success/failure, ignores repeated activation while busy and leaves later Tab navigation in place; reset selection for a different search/filter; retain song selection and the same open album's track selection through ordinary page navigation; Back closes the album, clears its selection and restores its tile focus even after a page detour; opening from the list starts fresh, and library/account changes or restart clear temporary album selection; keep loaded songs/albums visible during a paging failure with explicit Retry; keyboard recovery focuses visible recovered results, the first new item after paging, or the heading of an empty page; failed retry retains its action, while later focus/navigation wins and background refreshes keep focus |

limits: Album/playlist navigation after refresh is a smoke check, not a new changed-server-data or permission pass. Existing invalidation predicate, rendering/selection and B10/B11 records retain their original scope.
Native AX exposes aria-disabled as disabled; DOM proves native disabled=false and native Tab proves the action remains in sequential navigation.
Later-navigation completion is observed in native AX before Shift-Tab; its named settled snapshot is captured after Shift-Tab returns to Refresh.
Busy icon spinning class and focus geometry/styles are read-only observations. No separate screenshot or complete theme/accessibility audit is claimed.

No unit, VoiceOver, listener, live-provider/server, audible-quality, platform-matrix, release/package or deferred smaller-window/enlarged-zoom check. Cold detail-entry and complete app-wide controls remain Q06 work.
